author: kurokaage
quote: Honestly one of the best games ever made, period.Everything about Red Dead Redemption 2 is on another level. The open world feels genuinely alive, like every NPC has their own life and something random can happen every two minutes while you're just riding your horse.Arthur Morgan is easily one of the greatest main characters in gaming history. The story starts a bit slow, sure, but once it picks up, it hits like a truck. Between the incredible writing, the insane attention to detail, and just getting lost hunting or exploring for hours, nothing else really comes close.A true masterpiece that everyone needs to play at least once.

author: kurokaage
quote: Honestly the best Dragon Ball game we've had in years, especially after all the updates.When it first dropped, it was already super fun and looked insane, just like the old Budokai Tenkaichi games. But let's be real, ranked was a mess with everyone spamming the same broken characters and clunky **** devs actually listened to the players though. With all the patches, they fixed the DP costs, made counters way more skill-based instead of pure spam, and smoothed out the camera and UI. Now the massive roster actually feels fair and super responsive to play.Fast, chaotic in the best way, and way better balanced than at launch. Easily a must-play if you're a DB fan.
